spine.labelText: At the conclusion of debate, the chair put the question on the motion to suspend the rules. Mr. Latta objected to the vote on the grounds that a quorum was not present. Further proceedings on the motion were postponed. The point of no quorum was considered as withdrawn.

hidden.labelText: DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 9084.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H6099-6100; text: CR H6099)
Mr. Latta moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Forwarded by Subcommittee to Full Committee by Voice Vote.
Subcommittee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
